error_direction_rationale: A compliance checker that can stay silent is worse than one that over-flags: every input the kernel cannot evaluate is a named refusal or a not_applicable element carrying manual_review_required, never a quiet pass.

branches.branch: Written first notice containing the (c)(2) information delivered or mailed at least 45 days before the premium charge is assessed.
branches.note: element first_notice_45_day_advance; calendar-day comparison of the charge date against first-notice + 45. Reachable conformance fixtures: compliant-full-sequence (met), breach-first-notice-45day (breached).

branches.branch: Reminder notice delivered or mailed at least 15 days before the premium charge is assessed.
branches.note: element reminder_15_days_before_charge. Reachable conformance fixtures: compliant-full-sequence (met), breach-reminder-15day-before-charge (breached).

branches.branch: Reminder notice not delivered or mailed until at least 30 days after the first notice.
branches.note: element reminder_30_days_after_first_notice. Reachable conformance fixtures: compliant-full-sequence (met), breach-reminder-30day-after-first (breached), breach-first-notice-45day (breached co-occurrence).

branches.branch: By the end of the 15-day period beginning on the reminder delivery date the servicer has not received evidence of continuous compliant coverage; a charge assessed despite such evidence is not permitted.
branches.note: element no_continuous_coverage_evidence_before_charge; breached when the reported evidence date falls on or before the charge date. Reachable conformance fixture: breach-charge-despite-continuous-coverage-evidence.

branches.branch: The first notice sets forth the eleven enumerated content items.
branches.note: element first_notice_content, evaluated only when first_notice_content_items is supplied (closed item keys c2_i..c2_xi); otherwise not_applicable with a named note. Reachable conformance fixtures: notice-content-complete-plus-first-class-mail (met), notice-content-incomplete-breached (breached).

branches.branch: Mailed notices use a class of mail not less than first-class mail.
branches.note: element mail_class_at_least_first_class over the closed mail-class enum; not_applicable when notice_mail_class is not supplied. Reachable conformance fixtures: notice-content-complete-plus-first-class-mail (met), mail-class-below-first-class-breached (breached).

branches.branch: Within 15 days of receiving evidence of continuous compliant coverage the servicer must cancel the force-placed insurance and refund all premium charges and related fees for any period of overlapping insurance coverage.
branches.note: values-only: refund due date = evidence + 15 calendar days; refund owed computed pro-rata over the inclusive-day overlap of the charged coverage period and the borrower coverage period. Reachable conformance fixtures: breach-charge-despite-continuous-coverage-evidence (met), refund-breach-late-and-short (breached), refund-outstanding-no-action-yet (outstanding).

branches.branch: All charges related to force-placed insurance must be bona fide and reasonable; a bona fide and reasonable charge bears a reasonable relationship to the servicer's cost.
branches.note: values-only comparison table of charged premium against the borrower-provided alternative quote; the node NEVER labels a premium reasonable or unreasonable — the comparison is surfaced, the judgement is not. Reachable conformance fixtures: compliant-full-sequence (reported), benchmark-quote-missing-refused-values-only (refused on missing values).

branches.branch: A notice-sequence check without the first-notice, reminder or charge date cannot be evaluated.
branches.note: strict YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates within 1970-2099 only; anything else refuses.

branches.branch: A non-numeric or negative charged premium cannot enter a values-only benchmark.
A charged coverage period ending before it starts cannot support a pro-rata overlap computation.
Evidence of continuous coverage without the borrower coverage period cannot support a pro-rata overlapping-coverage refund.
A mail class outside the closed enum cannot be classified against the first-class floor.
Without borrower-provided alternative-quote values the benchmark reports a refusal branch (alternative_quote_missing), never a judgement.
A servicer may not assess a charge unless it has a reasonable basis to believe the borrower failed to maintain hazard insurance.

assumption_of_use.value: The charge date and amounts are supplied as facts of record; whether the servicer had a reasonable basis to charge is a fact question outside a values-only kernel.
assumption_of_use.source: VALON reduction map §B2 item 4 scope note (row FORCE-PLACED-CHECKER-1 step 2)
assumption_of_use.owner: FORCE-PLACED-CHECKER-1 staging (ORCH); surfaced as manual_review_required on any non-compliant verdict

branches.branch: Renewing or replacing existing force-placed insurance carries its own 45-day notice content and frequency rules.

assumption_of_use.value: This node checks the initial charge sequence only; renewal/replacement (e) notices are a named exclusion, not computed.

branches.branch: Flood-required insurance under the Flood Disaster Protection Act is not force-placed insurance under this section.

assumption_of_use.value: No flood-vs-hazard distinction is drawn beyond the section's own scope; FDPA-overlay charges are a named refusal-adjacent exclusion, never computed here.
assumption_of_use.source: row FORCE-PLACED-CHECKER-1 step 2 named exclusions (no flood-vs-hazard distinctions beyond §1024.37's scope)

branches.branch: Charges subject to State regulation as the business of insurance are carved out of the bona fide and reasonable rule.

assumption_of_use.value: No state force-placed-insurance overlays are modelled; state-law variance is a named exclusion of this node.
assumption_of_use.source: row FORCE-PLACED-CHECKER-1 step 2 named exclusions (no state FPI overlays)

branches.branch: Bold-text format requirements and the additional-information restriction on the written notices.

assumption_of_use.value: The kernel consumes values only (dates, amounts, a closed content-item checklist); document typography and layout cannot be represented and are not evaluated.
